title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )
write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: shark-attacks-world-map
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

attack_counts <- attacks |>
  count(Country_lower, name = "total_attacks")

world_attacks <- world |>
  mutate(Country_lower = str_to_lower(admin)) |>
  left_join(attack_counts, by = "Country_lower") |>
  mutate(total_attacks = coalesce(total_attacks, 0L))

ggplot(world_attacks) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = total_attacks), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    trans = "sqrt",
    name = "Shark Attacks"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Shark Attacks Around the World",
    subtitle = "Total recorded shark attacks by country",
    caption = "Source: Global Shark Attack Dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  filter(Fatal %in% c("Y", "N")) |>
  mutate(Fatal = recode(Fatal, "Y" = "Fatal", "N" = "Non-fatal")) |>
  count(Fatal)
```
